comments.configAutoLoaded: Config is auto-loaded by framework, no manual import needed
comments.commonFieldsMerged: Common fields (version, etc.) merged from common/config
comments.frameworkLanguage: Framework language (auto-detected from env, override to "en-US" if needed)
comments.devConfigOverride: Override only; framework deep-merges with main.ts
comments.commonConfigEntry: Common config entry (also used for single-app)
comments.commonConfigEntryDesc: Framework auto-loads and merges with app config; low priority
comments.commonConfigDesc: Shared by frontend/backend; framework deep-merges with app configs
comments.commonConfigNameVersionHint: name, version are set in each app src/<app>/config/main.ts; here only shared: language, server, router, render, build, logger.
comments.configHostPortInDevProd: host / port in main.dev.ts (127.0.0.1:{serverPort}) and main.prod.ts (0.0.0.0:{serverPort})
comments.commonConfigPortOverride: port overridden by each app config
comments.defaultExportSuffix: - shared fragment; each app spreads and overrides; set name, version in each app config.
comments.commonConfigImport: Common config (imported by other modules when version etc is needed)
comments.defaultExport: Default export; framework deep-merges into each app config
comments.tailwindScanPaths: Content scan paths for class generation
comments.unocssDesc: Write classes in components; unocssPlugin scans and merges output.
comments.dockerBaseStage: Base stage: install common tools (required for all services)
comments.dockerSwitchRoot: Switch to root for apt-get (Deno image default user is non-root)
comments.dockerInstallTools: Install common tools: curl for health checks, coreutils for tee
comments.dockerWorkDir: Working dir (compose mounts project via volumes)
comments.dockerDenoCache: Deno cache: run deno cache on host before first start, or mount runtime/deno-cache
comments.dockerMultiApp: Multi-app mode: one service per app
comments.dockerRunBuild: Run deno task build:<app> before docker-compose up
comments.dockerCacheMount: Optional: run deno cache first, then mount runtime/deno-cache for faster startup
comments.dockerRunBuildSingle: Run deno task build before docker-compose up
comments.dockerBaseStageMinimal: Base stage: Deno runtime only, no apt packages (to keep image size small)
comments.dockerWorkDirMount: Set working dir; compose mounts .:/app, run uses host project (run deno task build on host first)
comments.dockerWorkDirMountBun: Set working dir; compose mounts .:/app, run uses host project (run bun run build on host first)
comments.buildServerExternalBun: Bun runtime: server external includes engine and tailwind-related packages to avoid double-instance SSR errors
comments.commonUtilsImport: Import from apps: import { noop } from "@common/utils/mod.ts";
comments.commonModuleDesc: Shared {moduleName} layer for all apps; add and export as needed.
comments.renderFullDoc: See docs/APP_CONFIG.md for full options (SSR/SSG hydration, etc.); uncomment below as needed
comments.ssrHydrate: SSR only: enable client-side hydration (default true). Set to false to output server HTML only: no _client.js injected, no hydrate; links use full-page navigation; avoids refresh flicker.
comments.ssrHydrateOption: Enable client-side hydration. false = server HTML only, no _client.js, full-page nav, no refresh flicker.
comments.ssgHydrate: SSG only: enable client-side hydration for pre-rendered pages (default true). Set to false to not inject _client.js into static HTML; links will do full-page navigation.
comments.ssgHydrateOption: Enable client-side hydration for static HTML. false = no _client.js, full-page nav.
comments.renderFullDocFull: See docs/zh-CN/APP_CONFIG.md or docs/en-US/APP_CONFIG.md for full options (SSR/SSG hydration)
comments.frameworkLanguageSuffix: (auto-detected at init; override to zh-CN / en-US if needed)
comments.jsxDtsLine1: JSX intrinsic element types for project TSX type checking.
comments.jsxDtsLine2: Same as @dreamer/view jsx.d.ts; use with deno.json compilerOptions.types.
comments.nameDesc: Application name, used in logs and metadata.
comments.envPrefixDesc: Prefix for env vars to load into config (e.g. APP_PORT). Uncomment to enable.
comments.hotReloadDesc: Enable config hot reload in dev; framework restarts on config change.
comments.pluginManagerOptionsDesc: Plugin manager: autoActivate, continueOnError, enableHotReload, hotReloadInterval. Uncomment to customize.
comments.serverDesc: HTTP server: host, port, dev (HMR, watch), mode, onListen, onError, debug, shutdownTimeout.
comments.serverDevHmrDesc: Hot Module Replacement: enabled and path (e.g. /__hmr).
comments.serverDevWatchDesc: File watch paths and ignore patterns; triggers reload on change.
comments.serverModeDesc: Server mode (e.g. dev). Overridden by main.dev.ts / main.prod.ts in practice.
comments.serverOnListenDesc: Callback when server starts: ({ host, port }) => void.
comments.serverOnErrorDesc: Error handler: (error) => Response | void. Return Response to send custom error page.
comments.routerDesc: Router: routesDir, apiMode, redirects, skipAppValidation. See APP_CONFIG.md.
comments.apiModeDesc: API route style: restful or other. Uncomment to set.
comments.redirectsDesc: Array of { source, destination, permanent } for URL redirects.
comments.renderDesc: Render: engine (react|preact|view), mode (ssr|csr|ssg|hybrid), debug; ssr/ssg when applicable.
comments.renderEngineDesc: UI engine: view (recommended), preact, or react.
comments.renderModeDesc: Render mode: hybrid (SSR+client nav), ssr, csr, or ssg.
comments.renderDebugDesc: Enable render debug logs (default true in dev).
comments.ssgOutputDirDesc: SSG: output directory for pre-rendered static HTML.
comments.ssgRoutesDesc: SSG: list of paths to pre-render (e.g. ["/", "/about"]).
comments.buildDesc: Build: server (entry, output, compile, external), client, assets, build options. See APP_CONFIG.md.
comments.buildServerDesc: Server build: entry, output, target, compile, external, externalNpm, excludePaths, useNativeCompile, debug.
comments.useNativeCompileDesc: Use native compile for server (Bun/Deno). false = transpile only.
comments.buildServerEntryDesc: Server entry file (e.g. src/main.ts). Inferred if omitted.
comments.buildServerOutputDesc: Server output directory (e.g. dist). Inferred if omitted.
comments.buildServerCompileDesc: Compile options: minify, sourcemap, platform (linux, darwin, windows).
comments.buildServerExcludePathsDesc: Paths to exclude from server bundle.
comments.buildClientDesc: Client bundle: entry, output, engine, bundle, html, sourcemap, debug. Uncomment to customize.
comments.buildAssetsDesc: Assets: css (extract, minify, autoprefix), images, publicDir, assetsDir. Uncomment to customize.
comments.buildBuildDesc: Global build: mode, clean, cache, incremental, silent, logLevel. Uncomment to customize.
comments.loggerDesc: Logger: level, format, output (console, file), color, showTime, showLevel, tags, filter, maxMessageLength.
comments.loggerLevelDesc: Log level: debug, info, warn, error.
comments.loggerOutputDesc: Output targets: console (auto|true|false), file (path, rotate, strategy, maxSize, maxFiles).
comments.loggerOutputConsoleDesc: Console: auto (dev=stdout, prod=stderr), true, or false.
comments.loggerOutputFileDesc: File: path, rotate, strategy (size|time), maxSize (bytes), maxFiles.
comments.loggerColorDesc: Colorize console output. Uncomment to set.
comments.loggerShowTimeDesc: Include timestamp in log lines. Uncomment to set.
comments.loggerShowLevelDesc: Include level in log lines. Uncomment to set.
comments.loggerTagsDesc: Default tags for log entries. Uncomment to set.
comments.loggerFilterDesc: Filter: includeTags, excludeTags. Uncomment to set.
comments.loggerMaxMessageLengthDesc: Max log message length (bytes). Uncomment to set.
comments.databaseDesc: Database: default connection, named connections, managerOptions. Requires @dreamer/database. Uncomment and configure to use.
comments.databaseDefaultDesc: Default connection: adapter (sqlite|postgresql|...), connection (filename|host, port, database, username, password).
comments.databaseConnectionsDesc: Named connections (e.g. read, mongodb) for multi-db.
comments.socketDesc: Real-time: adapter (socketio|websocket), config (path, pingTimeout, pingInterval, transports, etc.). Uncomment to use.
comments.socketConfigDesc: Adapter-specific config (path, allowCORS, pingTimeout, pingInterval, transports, debug, etc.).
comments.sessionDesc: Session: store (e.g. createFileStore), name, maxAge, cookie, autoSave. Requires @dreamer/session. Uncomment to use.
comments.sessionCookieDesc: Cookie options: path, httpOnly, secure, sameSite.
comments.sessionAutoSaveDesc: Auto-save session on response. Default true.
comments.pluginsDesc: Plugins: array of path strings or { name, version, dependencies, config, onInit, onRequest, ... }. Uncomment to add.
comments.middlewaresDesc: Middlewares: array of { middleware, name?, condition? } or path strings. Uncomment to add.
comments.middlewareNameDesc: Middleware name for logs and ordering.
comments.middlewareConditionDesc: Condition: (req) => boolean; run middleware only when true.
